apps.description:
An unofficial native iOS live TV client for Viu members. Sign in once and watch live channels with the native player — AirPlay, Picture in Picture, external player options, favourites with hearts, per-channel language badges and a language filter, Kids and Sports modes, and parental controls. Liquid Glass interface with Dynamic Type for readability, in System, Light or Dark appearance.

Requires a Viu account. Live TV only.
apps.name: Viu Live TV
apps.subtitle: Live TV from Viu, natively on iOS

apps.description:
A multi-server music player for iOS. Connect Subsonic / Navidrome, Jellyfin or Plex servers, or play your on-device library and files imported from the Files app. Downloads for offline listening, Spotify playlist import, synced lyrics via LRCLIB, widgets, Siri shortcuts, an equalizer and sleep timer, genre and decade browsing, Song Radio, and ListenBrainz scrobbling.

A c12n rebuild of MatchaMusic, originally by Raiden Brundin.
apps.name: Matcha Music
apps.subtitle: Your music servers and library, one player

apps.description:
Tap Tap Phoenix remade for iOS 26 / 27 by c12n Apps, with the original credits kept. Tap the orbs in time with the music across the full song catalogue — including the hidden track 'Legend ft Backchat' by Jaroslav Beck and custom songs. Online accounts and leaderboards are revived on a c12n server, with an accessibility pack: wider Perfect / Great timing windows, high-contrast orbs, a No Fail practice mode and a song progress bar.

Remade for modern iOS by c12n Apps with ❤️ from Canada.
apps.name: Tap Tap Phoenix
apps.subtitle: The rhythm game, remade for modern iOS

apps.description:
RetroPhone runs real iPhone OS 3.1.3 and iOS 4.2.1 on modern iPhones using the S5LBox full-system emulator. Firmware downloads automatically from Apple with SHA-256 verification and imports itself — or import an IPSW from Files. Create machines, boot them, and watch live scanout diagnostics.

Note: the emulated display is a work in progress — the guest system boots, but the compositor may not draw yet on some builds.
apps.name: RetroPhone
apps.subtitle: iPhone OS 3.1.3 and iOS 4.2.1, emulated

apps.description:
S5LBox boots Apple's actual kernel, launchd and SpringBoard from iPhone OS 3 and iOS 4.2.1 inside an app on a modern iPhone. A from-scratch, full-system S5L8900 / ARMv6 emulator in portable C.

This is the standalone emulator build; RetroPhone is the c12n app built on the same core.
apps.name: S5LBox
apps.subtitle: Boot real iPhone OS 3 / iOS 4 in an app

apps.description: Share your iPhone's internet connection with an iPad, Mac or travel router over WireGuard — even when your carrier plan blocks the built-in hotspot.
apps.name: Tether
apps.subtitle: Share your iPhone internet over WireGuard

apps.description: A modern calculator for iOS 17+ with calculation history, haptics, a unit converter, a colour picker, changeable app icons and a Duo UI. Clean, fast, and private — everything stays on your device.
apps.name: Calculator
apps.subtitle: A modern SwiftUI calculator

apps.description: Fastfetch for iOS — a tiny neofetch-style system information app. See your device model, chip, kernel, memory, storage and uptime at a glance, in classic Fastfetch style.
apps.name: Fastfetch
apps.subtitle: Neofetch-style system info for iPhone
